Amanda (product): Quick sync — we need to lock the launch gates for v2 route rollout and the customer cutover plan. posting proposed gates below, please comment with hard blockers by EOD.

Amanda (product): Proposed gates: 1) v2 routes parity for chat/completions + tool-calls (behavioral tests passing), 2) embeddings + rerank stable with <=1% regressions on key datasets, 3) telemetry + migration metrics in console, 4) rollback plan + automated fallback to v1, 5) migration docs + customer notification template.

Josh (eng-runtime): Couple notes: parity for tool-calls is tricky if we change the route shapes. we need a compatibility wrapper for old `tools` schema or customers will break. I can prototype a mapping layer but it'll add ~2-3 days.

Priya (eng-ml): On embeddings/regression: we ran evals on 4 customers' workloads, v2 quantized model shows 0.8% MRR drop for one dataset. we can mitigate with a fallback to full-precision for flagged customers. recommend gate: "rollback to model variant per-customer."

Marco (solutions): From customer side: cutover windows need to be optional. enterprise customers expect opt-in and a way to test with canary traffic. please include an explicit canary opt-in API we can enable per-account.

Leo (platform): Telemetry: we need these metrics in console before GA: per-route error rate, p50/p95 latency, tokens per call, migration adoption %. I can add dashboards but need the event schema by COB tomorrow.

Sam (eng-sre): Rollback plan must be automated: if v2 error rate > 2% for 5m or p95 latency regresses > 2x, traffic should shift to v1. also require runbook for partial region failovers.

Josh (eng-runtime): Agree on automated fallback. here's a minimal header mapping we can support in the compatibility shim: `x-redwood-client-version` -> route selector; if missing, treat as v1. Example mapping snippet:
```json
{"headers": {"x-redwood-client-version": "v2"}, "map": {"v1.tools": "v2.tool_calls"}}
```
We'll implement as config-driven to avoid code churn.

Priya (eng-ml): About structured output changes: ensure we keep the same top-level keys for backward compat (`choices`, `usage`). if we add new `blocks` field in v2, it must be optional and not break existing parsers. add unit tests that assert unknown fields are ignored.

Marco (solutions): +1 on canary API. also need migration docs to include sample curl snippets for switching routes and an FAQ for common failures. customers will ask: "how long before v1 is deprecated?" we need a timeline.

Amanda (product): Suggested deprecation timeline: announce GA -> 6 months support window -> deprecation notice 90 days before forced switchover. open to adjusting for enterprise contracts. thoughts?

Leo (platform): 6 months is reasonable for self-serve. enterprise customers with contracts should get custom dates. we should expose per-account `migration_deadline` in the tenant API.

Sam (eng-sre): Add a safety buffer: during the final 30 days, we should enforce strict telemetry (heartbeat pings) and start a daily health digest to account teams.

Josh (eng-runtime): Implementation owners: I'll own the compatibility shim + rollback automation. Priya will own eval gates and model variant fallback. Leo will own telemetry dashboards. Amanda, can you own docs and customer comms? Marco to coordinate enterprise cutovers. Sam to own runbooks.

Amanda (product): Yes I'll own docs + comms. I'll draft a customer cutover template and an external FAQ. I'll also schedule a 30m review with legal for the timeline wording.

deploy-bot: Deployed `migration-schema-v1` to staging at 2025-10-18T14:22:10Z — tests: 72/74 passing.

Priya (eng-ml): Nice — which two tests failed?

deploy-bot: Failing tests: `embedding-regression/enterprise-dataset-3` (0.85% drop) and `structured-output/unexpected-field-handling` (parser strictness).

Josh (eng-runtime): Ok will add fallback for enterprise-dataset-3 and relax parser to ignore unknown fields. estimate: 1 day.

Amanda (product): Action items: 1) Josh: compatibility shim + rollback automation (ETA 3 days), 2) Priya: evaluate model fallback & add tests (ETA 2 days), 3) Leo: telemetry schema + dashboards (ETA 2 days), 4) Marco: customer canary plan + templates (ETA 3 days), 5) Sam: runbooks & region failover playbook (ETA 3 days), 6) Amanda: docs + comms + legal review (ETA 4 days). I'll collate these into a PRD and share tomorrow. :tada:

Marco (solutions): Thanks — I'll also prepare a short checklist for SEs to run during cutover.

Priya (eng-ml): Fine with ETAs. dropping a note: include a test that simulates `x-redwood-client-version` absent clients.

Josh (eng-runtime): Will add. tagging @here for visibility. :eyes:
